_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Management System Documentation
summary: The Management System Documentation DID assists the Government in developing Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program (NNPP) Management System documents and training materials.
use_relationship:
The Management System documents will assist the Government in the development of the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program (NNPP) Management System documents and training materials.
This Data Item Description (DID) is applicable to contracts requiring Management System documents. These are required in order to comply with the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 17025 Section 8.2. International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 17025 contains the requirements for National Voluntary Laboratory Accreditation Program (NVLAP) accreditation.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the discrete Contract Line Item (CLIN) as delineated in the contract Statement of Work (SOW). Document revisions affecting technical or quality assurance aspects will be provided upon revision.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: Management System documents shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The management system documents shall consist of all procedures related to:
